title: Star Wars Trilogy
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: STAR WARS Trilogy art can show up anywhere, even on the sides of lunch boxes. The front and back of a metal Thermos Co. lunch box with scenes from THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK seem luminous. They were painted by Thermos staff artist Gene Lemery. Twirl the box around to see Luke on Dagobah while his friends head into trouble. (Collection of William Plumb.)
